scripts.dev: npm run build:core && concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,green "npm -w @post/server run dev" "npm -w @post/dashboard run dev"
scripts.build: npm -w @post/core run build && npm -w @post/video run build && npm -w @post/server run build && npm -w @post/dashboard run build
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/video/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/dashboard/tsconfig.json
